summary: Investigated user bug 'Certain pick breakdown not loading like Matthew Boyd on app'. CANNOT REPRODUCE. Both Matthew Boyd picks (50b36be6 Over 2.5 Strikeouts ALT LOCK & 9484153a Over 14.5 Outs Recorded) AND a non-Boyd MLB pick (7369dce9 Red Sox +1.5 Spread) all load fully end-to-end on the web preview after authenticating as demo@lockscore.ai. Every panel renders with populated data: Header, Lock Score (94/94/95), Expected Win, Edge, Confidence, BOOK IMPLIED/ODDS, Share row, WHY THIS PICK explanation, FACTOR BREAKDOWN bars, UNIFIED PROBABILITY ENGINE, EVIDENCE, MONTE CARLO SIMULATOR + ALT LINE SENSITIVITY, RISK METER, DEEP THINKING (LockV2), MARKET COMPETITION, PITCHER vs TEAM (shown only for strikeout pick, correctly hidden for Outs Recorded by design), numbered reasons, CONFIDENCE/EDGE/RISK chips, KEY INSIGHTS, SHARE THIS PICK, disclaimer. Total scroll-content height ~5557px, body innerText ~5325-5396 chars for both Boyd picks. No JS errors (page_errors=[]), no stuck spinners post-load.
rca_of_issue: ROOT-CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: The user is almost certainly hitting a STALE CLIENT CACHE on their device. The web preview's console showed an explicit cachebust firing on this session: '[cachebust] L2 wiped AsyncStorage — backend data version: stored="none" → current="2026.06.24-admin-dashboard"'. The pick/[id].tsx file contains TWO defensive coalesce blocks with comments specifically about alt-line picks (e.g. tennis Tommy Paul, MLB pitcher/hitter alt-locks) crashing the route with 'Cannot convert undefined value to object' when factors/key_insights were missing (lines 280-301 and 437-454). The Matthew Boyd Over 2.5 Strikeouts pick IS an ALT LOCK — exactly the class of pick referenced in the comments. A pre-cachebust client without those defensive coalesces would have crashed on this exact pick. Iteration 56's lite=true did NOT cause this — the detail route calls /api/picks/{id} (full payload), confirmed via network trace returning 200 with all 90 fields populated. Recommend: (a) confirm user is on the latest client build; (b) if they reproduce, capture their React Native red-screen / JS stack trace to identify which panel actually crashes.

minor.issue: Returns 404 for every pick where it is called. XGFormPanel calls this on EVERY pick (not just soccer goalscorer) producing 3 console 'Failed to load resource: 404' errors per detail page render. Panel correctly hides UI but creates noise.
Returns 404 for non-MLB-prop picks. SimulatorPanel calls it on Red Sox spread pick producing 404 noise. Same pattern as player-form.

ui_bugs.issue: AI-generated markdown explanation for Boyd Over 2.5 Strikeouts renders literally — '## Why This Pick?' and '**Elite matchup edge**' show as raw text instead of rendered markdown. Boyd Over 14.5 Outs Recorded uses plain-text fallback (no markdown) and renders fine. The Strikeouts ALT LOCK pick triggers the live AI re-explain (ai_pending=true) and Claude returns markdown which is dumped into a <Text> component verbatim. From a user perspective, the breakdown can look 'broken' / unfinished.

integration_issues.issue: XGFormPanel and SimulatorPanel fire requests universally; ideally gate the fetch by sport/market like PitcherH2HPanel does (isMlbStrikeout pre-check). Avoids 404 spam and saves a roundtrip per non-applicable pick.

issues: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' fires repeatedly — React Native Web 0.19+ deprecation. Recommend audit StyleSheet shadows app-wide.

action_items: REPLY TO USER: bug is NOT reproducible on current build for either Matthew Boyd pick. Ask them to (a) force-quit and re-open the app to trigger the cachebust wipe (iteration 56), (b) screenshot what they're seeing, and (c) share any red-screen / error toast.

Add a markdown renderer (react-native-markdown-display or simple regex) for the WHY THIS PICK explainCard so AI-returned ## headings and **bold** render properly — this is the most likely user-visible 'broken' symptom.
Gate XGFormPanel network fetch behind a sport/market check (Soccer + goalscorer markets) the same way PitcherH2HPanel does; eliminates 404 noise.
Gate SimulatorPanel network fetch similarly (MLB props only).
Audit deprecated shadow* style props app-wide; migrate to boxShadow for RN Web 0.19+ compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: pick/[id].tsx is 671 lines — over the 700 soft cap is approaching; consider extracting the BentoCell + ScoreChip + share-action row + market panel-list into sub-components.

pick/[id].tsx lines 285 & 444 contain defensive `|| {}` / `|| []` coalesces with comments referencing past crashes from alt-line picks (the exact pick class user reported). Strongly suggests there was previously a real bug here, now patched — but ensure the patch shipped to all client builds via cachebust version bump (which iteration 56 did).

Both XGFormPanel and SimulatorPanel hit network universally then render nothing — wastes requests and pollutes console. Should mirror PitcherH2HPanel's `if (!eligible) return null;` early-out pattern BEFORE the useEffect fetch.
